sentences.en: Today, the justices of the Supreme Court keep testing the rules that govern their ethics.
sentences.zh: 今天，最高法院的大法官们不断考验着管辖他们职业道德的规则。

sentences.en: Adam Liptak reviews the allegations of misconduct and explores the growing calls to do something about it.
sentences.zh: 亚当·利普塔克回顾了有关不当行为的指控，并探讨了采取行动的日益高涨的呼声。

sentences.en: It's Monday.
sentences.zh: 今天是星期一。

sentences.en: Hello, Michael.
sentences.zh: 你好，迈克尔。

sentences.en: For once, Adam, we are not going to talk to you about a Supreme Court case.
sentences.zh: 亚当，破天荒地，我们今天不跟你谈论最高法院的案件。

sentences.en: Instead, we want to talk to you about the justices themselves and their ethics, if that's okay.
sentences.zh: 相反，如果我们可以的话，我们想跟你聊聊大法官们本身以及他们的职业道德。

sentences.en: It's a timely subject.
sentences.zh: 这是一个很应景的话题。

sentences.en: There's daily revelations about potential ethics problems at the Supreme Court.
sentences.zh: 关于最高法院潜在的道德问题的爆料每天都在发生。

sentences.en: Right, and that's exactly what we want to talk about, this slew of revelations over the past few weeks.
sentences.zh: 没错，这正是我们想谈的，过去几周里这一连串的爆料。

sentences.en: So, can you just summarize the biggest of those revelations?
sentences.zh: 那么，你能总结一下其中最大的一些爆料吗？

sentences.en: Well, the biggest ones by far all involve Justice Clarence Thomas and his relationship with a billionaire Republican donor named Harlan Crow.
sentences.zh: 嗯，迄今为止最大的爆料都涉及大法官克拉伦斯·托马斯，以及他与一位名叫哈伦·克劳的亿万富翁共和党捐赠者的关系。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: And the news organization ProPublica has now published three, how to characterize them, bombshells, I guess.
sentences.zh: 新闻机构ProPublica现在已经发表了三个，怎么形容呢，我猜可以算是重磅炸弹吧。

sentences.en: I'd call them bombshells.
sentences.zh: 我会称它们为重磅炸弹。

sentences.en: A brand new report is raising some serious questions about Supreme Court Justice Clarence
sentences.zh: 一项全新的报道正对最高法院大法官克拉伦斯

sentences.en: Thomas and the lavish gifts that he reportedly accepted from a GOP megadonor.
sentences.zh: 托马斯以及他据称接受一位共和党超级金主的奢华礼物提出一些严重的质疑。

sentences.en: So, the first article concerned luxury trips that Crow has provided to Justice Thomas and his family for seemingly decades.
sentences.zh: 所以，第一篇文章关乎克劳似乎在几十年里为托马斯大法官及其家人提供的豪华旅行。

sentences.en: The report says that the Thomases flew on Crow's private jet to Indonesia for the nine-day luxury vacation, one that they say is valued at more than $500,000.
sentences.zh: 报道称，托马斯一家乘坐克劳的私人飞机前往印度尼西亚进行为期九天的豪华度假，据称该假期价值超过50万美元。

sentences.en: Then a second ProPublica story reveals that Harlan Crow has purchased real estate from Justice
sentences.zh: 接着，ProPublica的第二篇报道透露，哈伦·克劳向大法官

sentences.en: Thomas.
sentences.zh: 托马斯购买了房地产。

sentences.en: A new report says a wealthy Republican donor owns the house where Supreme Court Justice
sentences.zh: 一份新报道称，一位富有的共和党捐赠者拥有最高法院大法官

sentences.en: Clarence Thomas' mother lives.
sentences.zh: 克拉伦斯·托马斯的母亲所住的房子。

sentences.en: To hear Harlan Crow tell it, he wants to turn this house into a museum to honor Justice Thomas, and he has paid money to have portraits done of Justice Thomas.
sentences.zh: 听哈伦·克劳的说法，他想把这栋房子变成一座博物馆来纪念托马斯大法官，并且他已经付钱让人为托马斯大法官画了肖像。

sentences.en: So, he's a big fan.
sentences.zh: 所以，他是个狂热粉丝。

sentences.en: And then on Thursday morning, ProPublica publishes a third story.
sentences.zh: 接着在周四早上，ProPublica发表了第三篇报道。

sentences.en: ProPublica reports this morning, the GOP billionaire donor Harlan Crow paid for the private school tuition for Clarence Thomas' grandnephew, who Thomas was raising as a son.
sentences.zh: ProPublica今天上午报道称，共和党亿万富翁捐赠者哈伦·克劳为托马斯抚养如亲儿子般的曾侄子支付了私立学校学费。

sentences.en: A member of Justice Thomas' family had his private school tuition for years paid by Harlan Crow, and not a trivial private school tuition.
sentences.zh: 托马斯大法官家族的一名成员多年来由哈伦·克劳支付私立学校学费，而且这不是一笔小数目的私立学校学费。

sentences.en: The total amount paid isn't known, but payments were made to two separate schools and could have exceeded $150,000.
sentences.zh: 支付的总金额尚不清楚，但款项分别支付给了两所不同的学校，可能超过了15万美元。

sentences.en: The report says that Thomas did not disclose the...
sentences.zh: 报道称托马斯没有披露...

sentences.en: Okay, so that's Justice Thomas, and it's a little bit of a doozy.
sentences.zh: 好吧，这就是托马斯大法官的事，这可真是一个不小的震撼。

sentences.en: What's next?

sentences.en: So, we're going to move into areas which are more complicated.

sentences.zh: 《政客》杂志报道称，戈萨奇在被确认任命九天后，终于为他与两个合伙人共同拥有的一处房产找到了买家。

sentences.zh: 《政客》杂志报道称，尼尔·戈萨奇大法官与一些合伙人在科罗拉多州拥有一些房地产。

sentences.en: And soon after Justice Gorsuch is confirmed to the court, the CEO of a prominent law firm,
sentences.zh: 就在戈萨奇大法官被确认加入法院后不久，一家知名律师事务所的首席执行官

sentences.en: Once the CEO learns that Gorsuch was one of the property's owners, he checks with the firm's ethics department, gets the okay to go forward with the sale.
sentences.zh: 一旦首席执行官得知戈萨奇是该房产的业主之一，他便与该事务所的道德部门核实，并获得批准继续进行这笔出售。

sentences.en: And this law firm, we should note, has had many cases before the Supreme Court.
sentences.zh: 我们应该指出，这家律师事务所有许多案件曾在最高法院审理。

sentences.en: In the 12 cases where Gorsuch's opinion is recorded, he sided with that firm's clients eight times.
sentences.zh: 在记录了戈萨奇意见的12起案件中，他有8次站在该事务所客户的一边。

sentences.en: And now there's Chief Justice John Roberts.
sentences.zh: 现在还有首席大法官约翰·罗伯茨。

sentences.en: Thirdly, there's Jane Roberts, the wife of Chief Justice John Roberts.
sentences.zh: 第三，还有首席大法官约翰·罗伯茨的妻子简·罗伯茨。

sentences.en: She's a lawyer.
sentences.zh: 她是一名律师。

sentences.en: Two years after the Chief Justice goes on the bench, she gives up her law practice because she doesn't want to cross ethical lines.
sentences.zh: 在首席大法官上任两年后，她放弃了律师业务，因为她不想触及道德底线。

sentences.en: She goes into a different business.
sentences.zh: 她转行做了别的业务。

sentences.en: She becomes a legal recruiter.
sentences.zh: 她成为了一名法律猎头。

sentences.en: She's very good at it.

sentences.en: But it can't hurt that you're the wife of the Chief Justice of the United States.
sentences.zh: 但身为美国首席大法官的妻子，这肯定也有所帮助。

sentences.en: Business Insider reporting that his wife made over $10 million recruiting for elite law firms, at least one of whom argued a case before the Supreme Court.
sentences.zh: 《商业内幕》报道称，他的妻子为精英律所搜罗人才赚取了超过1,000万美元，其中至少有一家律所在最高法院辩论过案件。

sentences.en: And questions have been raised also about whether that crossed an ethical line.

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.zh: 我知道这些质疑已经成为某人提起诉讼的一部分，此人自称是吹哨人，是简·罗伯茨的前同事。

sentences.en: of the head of the Supreme Court and you go around to law firms asking for their business, it's very hard for them to say no because they may think that saying no to the wife of
sentences.zh: 他们很难拒绝，因为他们可能会认为，对最高法院掌门人的妻子说“不”，可能会损害他们在首席大法官

sentences.en: the head of the Supreme Court might hurt their chances if they have a case before the Chief
sentences.zh: 和法院面前有案件时的胜算。

sentences.en: Justice and the court.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 这就概括了他的诉求。

sentences.en: That characterizes his claim.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 那么，亚当，所有这些情况自然而然地引发了一个问题，即大法官们是否违反了道德规则。

sentences.en: So, Adam, all of these situations naturally raise the question of whether the justices violated ethics rules.
sentences.zh: 因此，对于我们思考他们可能或可能没有违反的规则，有哪些相关的规定？

sentences.en: So, what are the relevant rules for us to be thinking about that they may or may not have violated?
sentences.zh: 这一领域的两项主要联邦法律适用于最高法院大法官，主要围绕

sentences.en: The two main federal laws in this area, which apply to Supreme Court justices, revolve around
sentences.zh: 财务披露，以及在您可能存在利益冲突的案件中主动要求回避、取消自己审判资格的必要性。

sentences.en: financial disclosures, and the need to recuse yourself, to disqualify yourself from a case in which you might have a conflict.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 让我们从披露规则的广泛概述开始。

sentences.en: Let's start with a broad summary of the disclosure rules.
sentences.zh: 它们并非不复杂，但基本上，它们要求披露大法官正常薪水之外的收入以及作为一般惯例的礼物，但有例外情况。

sentences.en: They are not uncomplicated, but basically, they require disclosure of income beyond the justices' normal salary and gifts as a general matter, with exceptions.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 那关于回避呢？

sentences.en: And what about recusal?
sentences.zh: 如果您在案件中拥有经济利益，或者如果您的配偶是案件的一方当事人，则有特定的回避要求。

sentences.en: There are particular requirements for recusal if you have, say, a financial stake in a case or if your spouse is a party to a case.
sentences.zh: 此外还有一个普遍原则，即法官和大审判官应当避免给人以不当行为的印象。

sentences.en: And then there's a general rule that judges and justices should avoid the appearance of impropriety.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 某种程度上自我判断某个情况是否需要他们退避三舍。

sentences.en: Kind of self-judge whether a situation requires them to kind of step back.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 亚当，那么这些规则，即这两个类别，如何适用于，比如说，托马斯大法官关于哈伦·克劳（他的这位亿万富翁朋友）送的所有这些礼物的爆料？

sentences.en: So how do these rules, Adam, these two categories, apply to, say, the Justice Thomas revelations of all of these gifts from Harlan Crow, this billionaire friend of his?
sentences.zh: 那我们逐一来看。

sentences.en: So let's do them one at a time.
sentences.zh: 我们有旅行。

sentences.en: We've got trips.
sentences.zh: 我们有房地产。

sentences.en: We've got real estate.
sentences.zh: 我们有学费。

sentences.en: We've got tuition.
sentences.zh: 至于旅行，法规明确排除了个人热情接待，并不要求披露。

sentences.en: As to trips, the statute carves out and doesn't require disclosure of personal hospitality.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，如果你去某人家里过夜，管你吃晚饭，你不需要报告这个。

sentences.en: You know, if you go to someone's house and stay overnight, you get fed dinner, you don't have to report that.
sentences.zh: 如果有人付费让你进行半个地球的旅行，这是否属于个人招待，则很不明确。

sentences.en: It's a lot less clear whether, if you have travel paid for to send you halfway around the world, whether that falls into personal hospitality.
sentences.zh: 但托马斯大法官在回应这一爆料时辩称，他当时得到咨询说这属于个人招待。

sentences.en: But Justice Thomas has argued in response to this revelation that he was advised at the time that it did.
sentences.zh: 他是说，即便是搭乘游艇你能想象到的最奢华的旅行，也属于朋友仅仅是热情好客的范畴。

sentences.en: He's saying that even the most luxurious trip imaginable on a yacht falls into the category of a friend is just being hospitable.
sentences.zh: 正如你所暗示的，从技术上讲，也许这是对的，但这似乎并不符合法律的意图。

sentences.en: And as you're hinting at, technically, maybe that is correct, but it doesn't seem like it's following the intent of the law.
sentences.zh: 是的，还有一个复杂的因素，就是负责为大法官解释法律的机构

sentences.en: Yes, and then there's a complicating factor, which is that the body in charge of interpreting
sentences.zh: 最近刚刚澄清了事情，并表示这种旅行不算数，这不属于个人热情接待。

sentences.en: the law for the justices has just recently clarified things and said this kind of travel doesn't count, that it's not personal hospitality.
sentences.zh: 在声明中，托马斯大法官表示今后他将进行披露。

sentences.en: And in his statement, Justice Thomas says going forward, he's going to disclose.
sentences.zh: 哦，哇。

sentences.en: Oh, wow.
sentences.zh: 所以也许他所做的事情直到最近才被认为是合乎道德的，但新规定称它实际上不再是了。

sentences.en: So maybe what he did was considered ethical until just recently, but new rules say that it no longer really is.
sentences.zh: 是的，这极具争议。

sentences.en: Yes, this is deeply contested.
sentences.zh: 许多人认为最初的法规对托马斯是不容置疑的，但最近的一项澄清明确了这种旅行不算数，这对他确实有帮助。

sentences.en: Many people think the original statute is unambiguous against Thomas, but it does help him that a recent clarification made clear that this kind of travel doesn't count.
sentences.zh: 好的，那我们来看房产交易。

sentences.en: Okay, so then we get to the real estate deal.
sentences.zh: 房产交易很简单。

sentences.en: The real estate deal is simple.
sentences.zh: 法律要求他披露。

sentences.en: The law required him to disclose it.
sentences.zh: 他没有披露。

sentences.en: He didn't disclose it.
sentences.zh: 毫无争议，这是违反披露法的行为。

sentences.en: There's no dispute that that was a violation of the disclosure law.
sentences.zh: 哈伦·克劳为他的亲戚支付的这些学费又如何呢？

sentences.en: And what about these tuition payments for his relative that Harlan Crowe made?
sentences.zh: 只要这是送给托马斯的礼物而不是送给曾侄孙的，根据法律，这显然也是一项本应披露的礼物。

sentences.en: So long as that's a gift to Thomas and not to the grandnephew, it seems plain also under the law that that's a gift that should have been disclosed.
sentences.zh: 事实上，几年前，当另一个人为这名曾侄孙支付了5,000美元学费时，托马斯大法官确实披露了。

sentences.en: And in fact, some years ago, when a different person paid $5,000 toward the tuition of this grandnephew, Justice Thomas did disclose it.
sentences.zh: 所以所有这些例子似乎都属于亚当所说的第一类规则，即围绕财务披露的规则。

sentences.en: So all these examples seem to fall under that first bucket of rules, Adam, around financial disclosure.
sentences.zh: 在少数情况下，托马斯大法官似乎非常明确地违反了这些规则。

sentences.en: And in a couple of cases, it seems Justice Thomas pretty clearly violated those rules.

sentences.zh: 在一项涉及2020年大选以及特朗普总统推翻该结果的努力的案件中主动回避，尽管

sentences.zh: 托马斯大法官的妻子吉尼非常积极地参与推翻2020年大选的活动。

sentences.zh: 所以这感觉很相关。

sentences.en: And so that feels relevant.
sentences.zh: 两次发表异议。

sentences.zh: 所以阻碍行政部门和国会这样做的唯一因素，可能只是一种历史观念，即它们不应干涉司法机构。

sentences.en: So the only thing holding the executive and congressional branches back from doing this may just be a historical sense that it shouldn't meddle in the judiciary.
sentences.zh: 但你是说，它们开始进行干预有着逻辑上的空间。

sentences.en: But you're saying there is a logical space for them to start to intervene.
sentences.zh: 而这基本上就是围绕着执行伦理规则。

sentences.en: And it's around basically just enforcing ethics rules.
sentences.zh: 是的，没错。

sentences.en: Yes, that's right.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，这场讨论是理论上的，且带有党派色彩。

sentences.en: On the other hand, this discussion is theoretical and tinged with partisanship.
sentences.zh: 之所以是理论上的，是因为很难想象这个两极分化的国会会采取任何行动。

sentences.en: Theoretical because it's pretty hard to imagine that this polarized Congress is going to take any action.
sentences.zh: 之所以带有党派色彩，是因为这场讨论越来越多地被共和党人描绘成自由派对法院裁决的不满。

sentences.en: And then partisan because increasingly this discussion is being framed by Republicans as unhappiness by liberals about the court's rulings.
sentences.zh: 以及他们所说的针对一位他们从未在乎过的大法官克拉伦斯·托马斯的党派抹黑行动。

sentences.en: And what they would call a partisan hit job against a justice they've never cared for, Clarence Thomas.
sentences.zh: 好的，所以你所反映的是共和党人的主张，即这场关于伦理的讨论实际上只是对这个法院的不满，借口是出于对大法官行为的高尚担忧。

sentences.en: Okay, so what you are reflecting is the Republican claim that this ethics discussion is kind of really just a level of upset with this court masquerading as, you know,
sentences.zh: 但我认为站在民主党人的立场来看，他们会简单地说，所有这些围绕保守派大法官的伦理问题被提出，并不是我们的错。

sentences.en: a high-minded worry about the justice's conduct.
sentences.zh: 是他们的行为造成了这个问题。

sentences.en: But I think to inhabit the Democrats' side of this, they would simply say it's not our fault that all these ethical questions are being raised around conservative justices.
sentences.zh: 对，而共和党人可能会反驳说，最高法院废除了宪法赋予的堕胎权、激怒了部分国民之后，紧接着就对大法官的行为进行更密集的审查，特别是针对右翼大法官的行为，这难道是巧合吗？

sentences.en: It's their conduct that has created that problem.
sentences.zh: 对，所以这是一种没完没了的先有鸡还是先有蛋的局面。

sentences.en: Right, and Republicans might say back that is it a coincidence that after the Supreme Court does away with the constitutional right to abortion, enraging part of the nation,
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: there is much more intensive scrutiny of the justice's conduct, and particularly the conduct of the justices on the right.
sentences.zh: 好的，我们一直在讨论政府的两个分支可能干预司法部门，但还有另一个选择，对吧？

sentences.en: Right, so this is kind of an endless chicken-and-egg situation which came firSt.
sentences.zh: 也就是在最高法院内部或周围可以建立一个内部司法执行机制，对吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Okay, so we've been talking about the two branches of government potentially intervening in the judiciary, but there's another option, right?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，司法部门可以做点什么。

sentences.en: Which is that there could be an internal judicial enforcement mechanism inside or around the Supreme Court, correct?
sentences.zh: 它可以尝试找出一种方法来获得裁决，甚至可以是非约束性裁决，但必须是咨询意见，由大法官本人以外的人提供。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 可以是一个总监察长、一个申诉专员、一个由受人尊敬的退休法官组成的专家组。

sentences.en: I mean, the judicial branch could do stuff.
sentences.zh: 由大法官本人以外的人来判定这种行为是否得体。

sentences.en: It could try to figure out a way to get rulings, maybe even non-binding rulings, but advisory opinions, something from somebody other than the justice, him or herself.
sentences.zh: 因此，大法官们将不得不授权在司法系统内部建立这样一个机构，说实话，

sentences.en: Could be an inspector general, an ombudsman, a panel of respected retired judges.
sentences.zh: 这个机构将开始正式对大法官的伦理行为进行事后指责和强制执行。

sentences.en: Somebody other than the justice, him or herself, to say this conduct is proper, this conduct is not.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So the justices would have to authorize the creation of such a body to be housed within the judiciary that, let's be honest,
sentences.zh: 所以他们不会倾向于这样做，而且在某种程度上这可能会带来问题，因为如果该机构对最高法院拥有实际的执行权力，

sentences.en: would start to officially second-guess and enforce the justice's ethical behavior.
sentences.zh: 这不仅会让法院感到奇怪，而且可能与设想最高法院具有最高地位的宪法相抵触。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 我希望面对来自申诉专员、法官小组或其他机构的成熟指导，

sentences.en: So they're not going to be inclined to do that, and at some point it may become problematic because if that body has actual enforcement power over the Supreme Court,
sentences.zh: 大多数大法官在大多数时候会说，听着，我可能同意，我也可能不同意，但我不会危及我所在机构的声誉，

sentences.en: that's going to strike the court as not only odd, but maybe in tension with the Constitution, which imagines that the Supreme Court is supreme.
sentences.zh: 我会服从这一判断。

sentences.en: I would hope that in the face of sophisticated guidance from the ombudsman or panel of judges or whatever,
sentences.zh: 我希望在面对来自申诉专员或法官小组等机构的成熟指导时，

sentences.en: most justices most of the time will say, listen, I may agree, I may disagree, but I'm not going to imperil the reputation of my institution,
sentences.zh: 大多数法官在多数情况下会说，听着，我可能同意，也可能不同意，但我不会拿我所在机构的声誉去冒险，

sentences.en: and I'm going to abide by that judgment.
sentences.zh: 我会服从那个裁决。

sentences.en: So in the end, that option would rely on the goodwill and the good graces of the justices, so in a way, it's still kind of a version of the current system of self-policing.
sentences.zh: 所以到头来，那个选项只能依靠大法官们的善意和恩准，所以在某种程度上，它仍然算是一种现行自我监管制度的变体。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It's a puzzle about how to enforce ethics rules in a body that is charged with being the final decision maker on all manner of things.
sentences.zh: 这是一个难题：如何在负责对各类事情做出最终裁决的机构中执行道德规则。

sentences.en: But these are nine smart people.
sentences.zh: 但这些人都是聪明人。

sentences.en: If they really wanted to solve the problem, they could.
sentences.zh: 如果他们真的想解决这个问题，他们是做得到的。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Key word there, if they really wanted to solve the problem.
sentences.zh: 其中的关键词是：如果他们真的想解决这个问题。

sentences.en: And so far, we haven't seen any evidence that these justices want to firm up the ethical rules around them.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，我们还没有看到任何证据表明这些大法官想要收紧他们周围的道德规则。

sentences.en: And I think what they think is that all of this stuff is a distraction.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为他们的想法是，所有这些事情都只是一种干扰。

sentences.en: The real question is, is any of this activity causing them to vote differently than they otherwise would have voted?
sentences.zh: 真正的问题是，这些活动有没有导致他们做出与平时不同的投票选择？

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And Clarence Thomas may have taken all manner of gifts and transactions from Harlan Crow and may have crossed ethical lines,
sentences.zh: 克拉伦斯·托马斯可能接受了哈兰·克劳提供的各种礼物和交易，并且可能越过了道德红线，

sentences.en: but I don't know that a lot of people think that Clarence Thomas is voting differently because of this relationship.
sentences.zh: 但我不知道有多少人会认为克拉伦斯·托马斯是因为这种关系而改变了投票。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: He's a committed conservative with an idiosyncratic but consistent judicial philosophy.
sentences.zh: 他是一位坚定的保守派，有着特立独行但始终如一的司法哲学。

sentences.en: And the court probably thinks that until you get to the point where someone is actually being bribed to change a vote, you don't have an authentic problem.
sentences.zh: 法院可能会认为，在真正有人被收买以改变投票结果之前，你都算不上遇到了真正的问题。

sentences.en: Fair point.
sentences.zh: 有道理。

sentences.en: But that's perhaps not the real issue here, Adam, right?
sentences.zh: 但亚当，这或许并不是这里真正的问题，对吧？

sentences.en: The real issue is whether we have faith that the justices are living according to the rules, right?
sentences.zh: 真正的问题是，我们是否相信大法官们是在按照规则行事，对吧？

sentences.en: Whether they are unbiable and conforming to the law.
sentences.zh: 他们是否不受收买并遵纪守法。

sentences.en: And I think what we're learning here is that there really isn't a practical scenario in which these rules get enforced anytime soon
sentences.zh: 我认为我们现在了解到的是，在不久的将来，确实没有一个切实可行的方案能够真正强制执行这些规则，

sentences.en: beyond the justices' own decision to follow the rules other than the pressure they might be facing from all the journalism that we have been describing here.
sentences.zh: 除了大法官们自己决定遵守规则之外，唯一的压力大概就来自我们一直在描述的这些新闻报道所带来的压力了。

sentences.en: I mean, there's now kind of a full-time industry of investigations going on into their behavior.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，现在针对他们行为的调查已经变成了一种全职行业。

sentences.en: And the question is, is that going to be sufficient to change anything?
sentences.zh: 问题是，这足以改变任何事情吗？

sentences.en: So a few things.
sentences.zh: 所以有几点看法。

sentences.en: The bar shouldn't be am I complying with the law.
sentences.zh: 标准不应该是“我是否遵守了法律”。

sentences.en: The bar should be am I holding myself to the highest possible ethical standards because I have life tenure on the United States Supreme Court
sentences.zh: 标准应该是“我是否在用最高的道德标准要求自己”，因为我在美国最高法院拥有终身任职资格，

sentences.en: and nobody should be able to question my judgment.
sentences.zh: 而且没有人应该能够质疑我的判断力。

sentences.en: So there should be some power of shame.
sentences.zh: 所以应该存在某种羞耻的力量。

sentences.en: There should be some power of saying, you know, late-night comedians are making fun of me.
sentences.zh: 应该有这样一种力量，让人觉得：你知道的，深夜脱口秀喜剧演员们都在拿我开玩笑。

sentences.en: Maybe they have a point.
sentences.zh: 也许他们说得有道理。

sentences.en: The average American thinks it's unseemly in the extreme to be hobnobbing with a billionaire on his luxury yacht
sentences.zh: 普通美国人会觉得，和一个拥有一艘豪华游艇、

sentences.en: who's a big Republican donor, who has all kinds of ideological interests.
sentences.zh: 且热衷政治捐款并有着各种意识形态诉求的亿万富翁厮混在一起，极其不得体。

sentences.en: And maybe, you know what, maybe I should do that thing I claim to do, which is get in my RV, as Clarence Thomas likes to say,
sentences.zh: 也许，你知道吗，也许我应该做我标榜自己会做的事，正如克拉伦斯·托马斯喜欢说的那样，开着我的房车，

sentences.en: and hang out in the Walmart's parking lot with ordinary people.
sentences.zh: 去沃尔玛的停车场和普通人待在一起。

sentences.en: And that's, you know, that's a great look.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，那看起来确实很棒。

sentences.en: But it turns out that's not the only look.
sentences.zh: 但事实证明，那并不是唯一的形象。

sentences.en: So maybe put aside mechanisms and separation of powers and ethics rules and statutes.
sentences.zh: 所以，也许我们可以把机制、三权分立、道德规则和法规先放在一边。

sentences.en: Maybe what we can hope for is what these revelations will cause the court to do, maybe I'm too optimistic, is to take stock and just be better.
sentences.zh: 也许我们能期望的是，这些丑闻会促使法院做出改变——也许我太乐观了——那就是反省自己，变得更好。

sentences.en: Just present yourselves to the American people as a body that's not capable of being influenced by outlandish gifts from billionaires.
sentences.zh: 向美国人民展现这样一个机构：它不会被亿万富翁的奇珍异宝所左右。

sentences.en: Well, Adam, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，亚当，非常感谢。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: Since we spoke with Adam, new questions about the conduct of Supreme Court justices have arisen.
sentences.zh: 在我们与亚当交谈后，关于最高法院大法官操守的新问题又浮出水面。

sentences.en: The Washington Post reported that in 2012, a prominent conservative activist arranged for Justice Thomas' wife, Ginny,
sentences.zh: 《华盛顿邮报》报道称，2012年，一位著名的保守派活动人士安排大法官托马斯的妻子吉尼，

sentences.en: to receive $25,000 from a nonprofit with business before the court.
sentences.zh: 从一家与最高法院有业务往来的非营利组织那里获得了25,000美元。

sentences.en: Paperwork reviewed by the Post showed that the activist sought to conceal the fact
sentences.zh: 《华盛顿邮报》审查的文件显示，该活动人士试图掩盖这样一个事实：

sentences.en: that the money was intended for Mrs. Thomas, instructing that there be, quote, no mention of Ginny.
sentences.zh: 这笔钱是给托马斯夫人的，并指示“绝对不要提及吉尼”。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, The Daily Wire reported that Justice Sonia Sotomayor declined to recuse herself from multiple copyright infringement cases
sentences.zh: 与此同时，《每日电讯报》报道称，大法官索尼娅·索托马约尔拒绝在多起侵犯版权案中回避，

sentences.en: involving the book publisher Penguin Random House, despite the fact that the publisher has paid Sotomayor millions of dollars to write a series of books.
sentences.zh: 这些案件涉及图书出版商企鹅兰登书屋，尽管该出版商已经向索托马约尔支付了数百万美元的稿费来撰写一系列图书。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们去去就回。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: We are here to crown a king.
sentences.zh: 我们来到这里是为了加冕一位国王。

sentences.en: In a solemn ritual that stretches back more than a millennium, Charles III was crowned as king on Saturday
sentences.zh: 在延续了千百年的庄严仪式中，查尔斯三世于周六加冕为国王，

sentences.en: after serving as the designated successor for longer than anyone in the history of the British monarchy.
sentences.zh: 在此之前，他担任指定继承人的时间超过了英国君主历史上任何一个人。

sentences.en: I, Charles, do solemnly and sincerely, in the presence of God, profess, testify, and declare
sentences.zh: 我，查尔斯，在上帝面前庄严而诚挚地承认、作证并宣告：

sentences.en: that I am a faithful Protestant, and that I will, according to the true intent of the enactments which secure the Protestant succession to the throne,
sentences.zh: 我是一名忠实的抗议宗信徒，并且我将根据确保抗议宗王位继承权的法案的真实意图，

sentences.en: uphold and maintain the said enactments to the best of my powers according to law.
sentences.zh: 依法尽我最大努力拥护并维护上述法案。

sentences.en: During the service, the first coronation since that of his mother, Queen Elizabeth II, in 1953,
sentences.zh: 在这次加冕仪式——自1953年其母亲伊丽莎白二世女王加冕以来的首次加冕——期间，

sentences.en: Charles was anointed with holy oil and fitted with a crown that features 2,868 diamonds,
sentences.zh: 查尔斯被涂抹圣油，并戴上了镶嵌有2688颗钻石、

sentences.en: 269 pearls, 17 sapphires, and 11 emeralds.
sentences.zh: 269颗珍珠、17颗蓝宝石和11颗祖母绿的王冠。

sentences.en: God saves the king!
sentences.zh: 国王万岁！

sentences.en: God saves the king!
sentences.zh: 国王万岁！

sentences.en: Moments later, the Archbishop of Canterbury invited the British people to celebrate their new king.
sentences.zh: 片刻之后，坎特伯雷大主教邀请英国人民为他们的国王庆祝。

sentences.zh: 今天的节目由玛丽·威尔逊、罗布·齐普科和妮娜·费尔德曼制作，威尔·里德和克莱尔·特内斯凯特提供了协助。

sentences.en: It was edited by Rachel Quester, with help from Lisa Chow and Mark George, fact-checked by Susan Lee, contains original music by Dan Powell and Marion Lozano,
sentences.zh: 节目由瑞秋·奎斯特剪辑，丽莎·周和马克·乔治提供了协助，苏珊·李负责事实核查，原创音乐由丹·鲍威尔和马里昂·洛扎诺创作，

sentences.en: and was engineered by Chris Wood.
sentences.zh: 克里斯·伍德担任音频工程。

sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由Wonderly的吉姆·布伦伯格和本·兰斯堡创作。

sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受严密控制的机器在运转。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: I'm sorry.
sentences.zh: 我很抱歉。

sentences.en: Order.
sentences.zh: 肃静。

sentences.en: I'm hoping.
sentences.zh: 我希望。

sentences.en: Order.
sentences.zh: 肃静。

sentences.en: Yeah, order to be.
sentences.zh: 对，保持肃静。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了大批自称改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 自那以后，该党一直陷入激烈、混乱且有时扣人心弦的权力争斗中。

sentences.zh: 在由我萨拉·科尼格主持的最新一期《地铁》节目中，我们将讲述人们试图维持影响力却最终失控的故事。

sentences.zh: 《地铁》。
